title: Reefer Cargo Services: Ventilation and Humidity Control by Tier
content:
Two optional carrying settings of Reefer Cargo Services vary by tier: fresh-air ventilation, measured in cubic metres per hour, and dehumidification, expressed as a relative humidity set point in whole percent. Whether a tier offers each setting, and within which limits, is fixed per tier as follows.

| Tier | Fresh-air ventilation offered | Highest ventilation (m³ per hour) | Dehumidification offered | Humidity set point, lowest (%) | Humidity set point, highest (%) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | yes | 285 | no | 0 | 0 |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | yes | 285 | yes | 60 | 95 |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | no | 0 | no | 0 | 0 |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | no | 0 | yes | 70 | 95 |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | no | 0 | yes | 35 | 75 |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | no | 0 | no | 0 | 0 |

A zero in a limit column simply reflects that the tier does not offer that setting; the humidity bounds carry meaning only on the three tiers where dehumidification is available.

## Setting availability at a glance

- Ventilation open to fresh air: Standard and Monitored only, each up to 285 cubic metres per hour.
- Dehumidification: Monitored (60 to 95 percent), Controlled Atmosphere (70 to 95 percent) and Pharma GDP (35 to 75 percent).
- Neither setting: Cold Treatment and Superfreezer.
- Both settings together: Monitored alone.

## Hypothetical comparisons

- A shipper wanting 150 cubic metres per hour of fresh air together with a 65 percent humidity set point finds both values inside the Monitored limits, and no other tier offers the pair.
- A humidity set point of 40 percent lies inside the Pharma GDP limits only.
